rationale: Recurring isolated form on this page (line 9, line 11 ×2). Most plausibly the Coptic numeral 111 (ⲣ̄=100 + ⲓ̄=10 + ⲁ̄=1 with overline as numeral marker), serving as kephalaion-number marker either closing the previous chapter or labeling the new one. The repetition in line 11 framing 'in the eye and the hidden fifth' is unusual; could be marginal/structural notation imported into the line. Alternative readings (Greek -ρία word, Lyc verbal compound) fit less well. Flagged for parallel attestation in adjacent pages.

Unattested in our corpus. Context 'ⲟ̄ⲁⲥ ⲛ̄ⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ ⲉⲧⲏⲡ ⲁⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ' = 'X of archons that belong to the Darkness' demands a quantifier or collective. Possibly Lyc reflex of ⲟⲩⲁⲥⲉ 'multitude' or related to ⲱⲁⲥ. Alternative 'cry/voice' (ⲟⲩⲁⲥ) doesn't fit syntax. Confidence low; awaits parallels.

proposed_english: the speech (?) / the matter / the time (uncertain)
rationale: Hapax in this corpus. In the parallel ⲍⲙ ⲡⲍⲣⲁⲩ ⲍⲙ ⲡⲥⲉ ⲍⲙ ⲡⲣ̄... 'in the voice, in the X, in the Y...' the term should be a domain/medium parallel with 'voice'. Best guesses: Lyc reduction of ⲡⲥⲉⲭⲉ 'speech', or ⲡⲥⲏⲩ 'time/season', or a sense-related term. Flagged for further attestation.

Reduplicated form of unidentified root. Context (the Light who watches what is hidden, identified with the Living Air) suggests an intensive/iterative verb of vigilance. Possibly cognate with ⲣⲟⲉⲓⲥ/ⲣⲁⲓ̈ⲥ 'watch' or with a Greek loan (ῥέω 'flow'?). The directional ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'forth' supports an emanative-action reading.

proposed_english: to conceal them / cause to be hidden
rationale: Causative ⲧ- + ⲍⲏⲡ ('hidden,' qualitative of ϩⲱⲡ) + 3pl object suffix -ⲁⲩ. Habitual 'whom they habitually conceal.' Fits the cosmological context of the metarrhismos/metallismos series — concealment as the third process for archons being driven out.
